entries.1b27718293807af6: This business model uses the user reach of ZOZOTOWN and the fashion media 'WEAR by ZOZO' to provide advertising space mainly to client companies, such as partner brands, and earn advertising revenue. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥11,884 million (up 6.0% year on year), and no merchandise transaction volume is recorded. This segment monetizes the presence of people on the sites themselves, and its revenue is generated differently from segments that sell products.
entries.1da3ccc055dd7e10: This business model involves brands opening shops on ZOZOTOWN in tenant format, with the company handling operational management after opening. Each brand's products are held as consigned inventory at the company's logistics bases and sold there. The main difference from purchase shops is that the tenant side carries out basic merchandising, and because this is a consignment sales model, the company does not bear inventory risk. Revenue from this business is recorded as consignment sales commissions on the products sold. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, merchandise transaction volume was ¥492,743 million (73.9% of merchandise transaction volume, up 5.2% year on year), while revenue from consignment sales commissions was ¥134,673 million (up 3.9% year on year). As of the end of March 2026, there were 1,689 shops in consignment sales.

entries.26e48f1763dd6ef9: The company operates under the corporate philosophy "Make the world cool, and bring smiles to the world." What it provides is, from the brands' viewpoint, a place to display and sell products together with the systems for its operation and management, logistics, delivery and payment, and, from the users' viewpoint, a site where they can choose from the products of many brands in one place. At the end of March 2026, the number of shops on ZOZOTOWN was 1,710 and the number of brands was 11,247. In logistics, it has a logistics base called ZOZOBASE, which began operating in August 2006, and it takes in consigned inventory and ships it. The company states that, aiming to expand the number of unique users and improve the conversion rate (the purchase rate of unique users) on ZOZOTOWN, it strengthened customer acquisition by broadcasting TVCM and placing WEB advertising during the sale event "ZOZOWEEK," the summer and winter main sales and the Black Friday period. In strengthening categories, it focuses on the cosmetics category "ZOZOCOSME," and, aiming to provide solutions centered on "suits you" that approach the upstream of purchasing, it states that it is advancing development of its own AI agent using the fashion-related data it has accumulated so far.
entries.2e32d17899c00bf5: ZOZO, Inc. mainly operates the fashion e-commerce site “ZOZOTOWN” and the fashion media “WEAR by ZOZO,” among others, and consists of the company and mainly 6 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]]. The reportable [[term:segment|segment]] is the single EC Business segment, within which the company presents results across 6 business categories. The key point in reading this company is that the price of merchandise does not directly become revenue. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the total value of merchandise transacted through the site (merchandise transaction volume) was ¥666,035 million, while revenue was ¥228,373 million, equal to 35.3% of merchandise transaction volume (excluding other merchandise transaction volume). In consignment sales, the largest business format, it holds brands’ merchandise as consigned inventory and sells it, and records only the consignment sales commission as revenue; because it does not bear inventory risk, the full merchandise price does not become revenue. By contrast, purchasing and manufacturing sales and USED sales are made from its own inventory, so the merchandise price becomes revenue, and the advertising business earns advertising revenue by selling advertising space. Accordingly, there are 2 types of customers: users who shop on the site, and brands that open stores on the site or place advertisements, both of which are customers. No counterparty accounts for 10% or more of revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026.

Shopping, an online shopping mall operated by LINE Yahoo Corporation, and selling products by opening ZOZOUSED on Yahoo! Auctions, an online auction service operated by the same company, since March 2024. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, merchandise transaction volume was ¥78,926 million (11.9% of merchandise transaction volume, up 13.4% year on year), and revenue from consignment sales commissions was ¥24,179 million (up 13.4% year on year). The company cites as reasons for the growth the retention of customers acquired through the previous fiscal year, customer acquisition by LINE Yahoo Corporation, which operates the mall, and the deployment of sales promotions such as 'Honki no ZOZO Matsuri'. LINE Yahoo Corporation is also the parent company, indirectly holding 51.9% of the company's voting rights.

entries.4a294d642c518115: ZOZO, Inc. has its head office in Inage-ku, Chiba City, Chiba Prefecture, and consists of the company and 6 mainly consolidated subsidiaries (ZOZO NEXT = creation of new businesses and research and development; ZOZO Apparel USA, Inc. = sales support for headquarters; ZOZO NEW ZEALAND LIMITED = development of measurement technology, etc.; Nantong Zhuoteng Xinxi Keji Co., Ltd. = consulting on production platforms; LYST LTD = operation of an online fashion platform; ZOZO U.K. LIMITED = holding company). The number of employees at the end of March 2026 was 1,894 (in addition, there were 5,434 temporary employees on average over the year). The company's parent company is Z Holdings Intermediate Corporation, which holds 458,858,700 shares of the company (voting rights ratio 51.9%). LINE Yahoo Corporation, A Holdings Corporation, SoftBank Corp., SoftBank Group Japan Corporation and SoftBank Group Corp. are also listed as parent companies, each with a voting rights ratio of 51.9%. Based on a resolution of the Board of Directors on March 31, 2026, the company acquired all shares of High Link Inc., which operates the comprehensive fragrance platform 'Kararia,' effective April 16.

entries.668234557d18838e: This is a secondary-distribution business model that mainly buys used fashion merchandise from individual users and others and sells it from the company's own inventory. The company positions it as a value-added service to promote purchases of new products. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, merchandise transaction volume was ¥21,074 million (3.2% of merchandise transaction volume, up 7.3% year on year), and revenue was ¥20,113 million (up 6.8% year on year). Because the goods are sold from the company's own inventory, merchandise transaction volume and revenue are almost the same amount.

It undertakes the construction, operation and logistics work of brands' own EC sites. As with consigned shops, revenue from this business is recorded as consignment sales commission on the commission for products sold. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, gross merchandise volume was ¥8,377 million (1.3% of gross merchandise volume, down 36.1% from the previous year) and revenue was ¥1,325 million (down 38.2%), making it the smallest of the 6 segments. The number of consigned sites as of the end of March 2026 was 29.

entries.af37a8854d4792c1: This is a business category that operates the fashion EC site "ZOZOTOWN" and consists of 3 business formats: "buying, manufacturing and sales," "consignment sales" and "USED sales." In the fiscal year ended March 2026, gross merchandise value was ¥516,613 million (77.5% of gross merchandise value) and net sales were ¥157,416 million, making it the largest of the 6 business categories. As of the end of March 2026, the number of shops on ZOZOTOWN was 1,710 shops and the number of brands was 11,247. The number of shops that newly opened during the fiscal year was 151 shops (a net increase of 61 shops), and the main newly opened shops cited include the outdoor brand "SALOMON," "sanrio house," a brand supervised by Sanrio Co., Ltd. and developed by Mash Style Lab Co., Ltd., and "Takarajimasha STORE," an apparel shop operated by the publisher Takarajimasha, Inc. The number of annual purchasers who purchased at least 1 time in the 1 year up to the end of March 2026 was 13,173,445 (of whom 12,479,312 were active members who are members, and 694,133 were guest purchasers).
entries.b29b3c6d884ecbbf: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, gross profit was ¥213.0 billion (up 7.4% year on year), and the ratio to merchandise transaction volume (excluding other merchandise transaction volume), the gross margin, was 33.0%, a decrease of 1.5 percentage points from the previous year. The company attributes the main factor in the decline to the change in business composition accompanying the consolidation of LYST, which has a low commission rate. Selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥143,634 million (up 7.5%), and the ratio to merchandise transaction volume was 22.2%, a decrease of 1.0 percentage point from the previous year. The company cites as factors for the decline that, because LYST operates under an affiliate model, no logistics-related costs, packing and shipping charges or payment collection fees arise and the amount recorded for rent and other items is limited; that the economic terms with delivery contractors improved from October 2025; and that work efficiency at logistics bases improved. It cites goodwill amortization and advertising expenses as factors for the increase. As a result, operating profit was ¥69,366 million (up 7.1%), ordinary profit was ¥69,261 million (up 6.7%), and net income attributable to owners of parent was ¥47,926 million (up 5.7%).
entries.b8d03edb2a70fac3: This segment covers businesses incidental to the ZOZOTOWN business (shipping fee income, payment fee income and others) and revenue related to other gross merchandise volume. Other gross merchandise volume includes the gross merchandise volume of stores that signed a ZOZO Option contract among the fashion category stores on Yahoo! Shopping excluding the ZOZOTOWN store (recording ended at the end of September 2025), the gross merchandise volume on the own EC sites of consolidated subsidiaries, the gross merchandise volume via "ZOZOMO", a mechanism that directs customers from ZOZOTOWN to offline stores, and the gross merchandise volume of "ZOZOSUIT", which is sold for a fee in the United States. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, other gross merchandise volume was ¥19,872 million (3.0% of gross merchandise volume, down 49.9% from the previous year), while other revenue was ¥27,791 million (up 5.0%), making it the 2nd largest of the 6 segments by revenue. While consignment sales record only the commission as revenue, shipping fee income and payment fee income become revenue as they are, so the ranking by gross merchandise volume and the ranking by revenue are reversed.

entries.bb7110536b001117: This business model earns performance-based commissions from partners that list products on Lyst, a fashion shopping platform. The company acquired all shares of LYST LTD (United Kingdom, London), which operates Lyst, on April 18, 2025, making it a wholly owned subsidiary, and has included it in consolidation since May 2025. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, merchandise transaction volume was ¥42,245 million (6.3% of merchandise transaction volume), and revenue was ¥5,776 million. The company explains that Lyst is a business with a lower commission rate relative to merchandise transaction volume than Consignment Sales and LINE Yahoo Commerce. In the current fiscal year, results fell below plan, against a backdrop that included a downturn in the luxury industry centered on European and US markets and changes in US tariff arrangements. The company says it will place Lyst at the core going forward and aim for discontinuous growth in global markets.

entries.e41cf4559130e817: This business model involves the company group purchasing merchandise and selling it while bearing inventory risk. It covers a model that purchases fashion merchandise from each brand and a model that sells MS (multi-size) and similar products while holding the company's own inventory. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, merchandise transaction volume was ¥2,795 million (0.4% of merchandise transaction volume, down 24.3% year on year), and revenue was ¥2,630 million (down 24.5% year on year), the smallest of the three models.
